tests.title: Unit 1: Introduction to English Grammar – Practice Test 1

questions.question_text: Choose the sentence that is grammatically correct.
options: Neither of the two proposals was accepted by the committee.
Neither of the two proposals have been accepted by the committee.
Neither of the two proposal was accepted by the committee.
Neither of the two proposals were accepted by the committee.

questions.question_text: Select the correct sentence.
options: The number of applicants have increased this year.
A number of applicants has increased this year.
The numbers of applicants has increased this year.
The number of applicants has increased this year.
questions.explanation: The number of... takes a singular verb.

questions.question_text: Select the correct sentence.
options: A number of students were absent from the seminar.
The number of students were absent from the seminar.
A number of students was absent from the seminar.
A number of student were absent from the seminar.
questions.explanation: A number of... takes a plural verb.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option: "Each of the managers ___ responsible for the budget of his department."
Choose the correct option: "The jury ___ unable to agree, and the judge dismissed them."
Choose the correct option: "Either the director or the managers ___ to attend the meeting."
questions.explanation: The verb agrees with the nearer subject.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option: "Neither the managers nor the director ___ aware of the delay."
questions.explanation: The verb agrees with the nearer subject, "director".

questions.question_text: Select the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Subjects ending in -ics take singular verbs.

questions.question_text: Select the correct sentence.
options: The scissors are on the table.
The scissor are on the table.
The scissors has been on the table.
The scissors is on the table.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option: "Ten thousand rupees ___ a large sum for a student."
questions.explanation: A sum of money is a single unit.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option: "She is one of those employees who ___ always punctual."
Choose the correct option: "He is the only one of the employees who ___ punctual."
Choose the correct option: "By the time the manager arrived, the meeting ___."
questions.explanation: Past perfect for the earlier action.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option: "I ___ in this company since 2018."
Choose the correct option: "When I reached the station, the train ___."
Choose the correct option: "If I ___ you, I would accept the offer."
Choose the correct option: "If the shipment had arrived on time, we ___ the deadline."
Choose the correct option: "Unless you ___ the form, your application will not be processed."
questions.explanation: Present tense in a conditional clause.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option: "I wish I ___ more time to prepare for the presentation."
questions.explanation: Wish about the present takes the past form.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option: "She suggested that he ___ the contract before signing it."
Choose the correct option: "He insisted that the meeting ___ postponed."
Choose the correct option: "The report, along with the invoices, ___ sent yesterday."
questions.explanation: "Along with" does not make the subject plural.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option: "Bread and butter ___ my usual breakfast."
Choose the correct option: "The manager as well as his assistants ___ present at the event."
questions.explanation: Verb agrees with the first subject.

questions.question_text: Which sentence uses the correct article?
options: She is the honest employee of an honour.
She is an honest employee of a honour.

tests.title: Unit 1: Introduction to English Grammar – Practice Test 2

questions.question_text: Which sentence uses the correct article?
options: He completed a one-year course in a university.
He completed an one-year course in a university.
He completed an one-year course in an university.
He completed a one-year course in an university.
questions.explanation: Sound-based rule: "one" and "university" begin with a consonant sound.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option: "She plays ___ violin very well."
questions.explanation: The is used with musical instruments.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option: "___ Himalayas are the highest mountain range in the world."
Choose the correct option: "He was elected ___ president of the society."
questions.explanation: No article for a unique office after verbs like elect.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option: "The price of petrol is higher than ___ of diesel."
questions.explanation: That refers back to the singular noun "price".

questions.question_text: Choose the correct preposition: "The firm has been accused ___ fraud."
Choose the correct preposition: "She is allergic ___ dust."
Choose the correct preposition: "He is senior ___ me by two years."
Choose the correct preposition: "The new policy is different ___ the old one."
Choose the correct preposition: "We must abide ___ the rules of the company."
Choose the correct preposition: "He congratulated me ___ my promotion."
Choose the correct preposition: "She prefers tea ___ coffee."
Choose the correct preposition: "The meeting has been postponed ___ next Monday."
Choose the correct preposition: "The flight is scheduled ___ 6:30 a.m. on Friday."
Choose the correct preposition: "They have been living in Pune ___ ten years."
Choose the correct preposition: "He has been absent ___ Monday."
Convert to indirect speech: He said, "I will call you tomorrow."
options: He said that he will call you tomorrow.
He said that he would call me the next day.
He said that I would call him the next day.
He said that he would call you tomorrow.

questions.question_text: Convert to indirect speech: She asked, "Where do you live?"
options: She asked that where I lived.
She asked where do I live.

questions.question_text: Convert to indirect speech: The manager said to me, "Submit the report today."
options: The manager ordered me to submit the report that day.
The manager ordered me that I submit the report that day.
The manager told that I should submit the report today.
The manager said me to submit the report today.

questions.question_text: Convert to direct speech: She said that she had finished the work.
options: She said, "I had finished the work."
She said, "She has finished the work."
She said, "I have finished the work."

questions.question_text: Change to the passive voice: "The committee approved the budget."
options: The budget was approved by the committee.
The budget approved by the committee.
The budget is approved by the committee.
The budget has been approved by committee.

questions.question_text: Change to the passive voice: "They are repairing the road."
options: The road is repaired by them.
The road was being repaired by them.
The road has been repaired by them.
The road is being repaired by them.

questions.question_text: Change to the passive voice: "Someone has stolen my laptop."
Change to the active voice: "The tickets will be booked by the agent."
options: The agent would book the tickets.
The agent will be booking the tickets.
The agent has booked the tickets.
The agent will book the tickets.

questions.question_text: Which sentence is in the passive voice?
options: The board will reject the proposal.
The board has been rejecting proposals.
The proposal was rejected by the board.

tests.title: Unit 1: Introduction to English Grammar – Practice Test 3

questions.question_text: Identify the error: "Each of the employees (A) have completed (B) their training (C) successfully (D)."
Identify the error: "The news (A) were (B) broadcast (C) on all channels (D)."
Identify the error: "He is (A) taller (B) than (C) any other (D) boys in the class."
options: D — "any other boys" should be "any other boy"
questions.explanation: Comparative with any other takes a singular noun.

questions.question_text: Identify the error: "The manager (A) told me that (B) he will (C) join the meeting (D) later."
options: B — "told me that" should be "said me that"

questions.question_text: Identify the error: "She does not (A) know (B) neither (C) of (D) them."
Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
options: The manager, who was late apologised, to the clients.
The manager, who was late, apologised to the clients.
The manager who, was late apologised to the clients.
The manager who was late, apologised to the clients.
questions.explanation: Non-defining clause set off with commas.

questions.question_text: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
options: It's a pity that the company has lost it's way.
It's a pity that the company has lost its way.
Its a pity that the company has lost it's way.
Its a pity that the company has lost its way.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option: "The CEO announced ___ the company would expand into Asia."
Select the sentence with the correct use of "its" or "it's".
options: The company changed it's policy because its profits fell.
The company changed its policy because its profits fell.
The company changed its policy because it's profits fell.
The company changed it's policy because it's profits fell.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option: "Hardly had he entered the room ___ the phone rang."
Choose the correct option: "No sooner did she sit down ___ the bell rang."
Choose the correct option: "Not only was he late, ___ he was also unprepared."
Choose the correct option: "Scarcely had we left ___ it began to rain."
Choose the correct option: "She is not only intelligent ___ hardworking."
Choose the correct word: "The new law will ___ many small businesses."
Choose the correct word: "The ___ of the new policy was immediate."
Choose the correct word: "Please ___ my apologies for the delay."
Choose the correct word: "The company decided to ___ the contract."
Choose the correct word: "Her ___ in the meeting was valuable."
Choose the correct word: "The auditor will ___ the accounts next week."
Choose the correct word: "We need to ___ the contract before we sign it."
Choose the correct word: "The manager ___ the team for the good results."
Choose the correct word: "The two colours ___ each other well."
Choose the correct word: "He gave me valuable ___ about my career."
Choose the correct word: "The ___ of the college addressed the students on the first day."

tests.title: Unit 1: Introduction to English Grammar – Practice Test 4

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option: "This is the book ___ I told you about."
Choose the correct option: "The man ___ car was stolen reported it to the police."
Choose the correct option: "To ___ shall I address the letter?"
Choose the correct option: "He gave the prize to ___ answered first."
Choose the correct option: "She is as talented as ___ in the group."
Which sentence has the correct parallel structure?
options: She likes reading, writing and travelling.
She likes reading, to write and to travel.
She likes reading, writing and to travel.
She likes to read, writing and travelling.

questions.question_text: Which sentence has the correct parallel structure?
options: The job requires to be patient, accurate and punctual.
The job requires patience, accuracy and being punctual.
The job requires patience, being accurate and punctuality.
The job requires patience, accuracy and punctuality.

questions.question_text: Which sentence avoids a dangling modifier?
options: Walking to the office, I saw an accident.
Walking to the office, the accident was seen by me.
Walking to the office, the traffic was heavy.
Walking to the office, an accident was seen.

questions.question_text: Which sentence is a fragment?
options: Although the shipment was delayed, we met the deadline.
The shipment was delayed because of the strike.

questions.question_text: Which is a run-on sentence?
options: The meeting ended, and we went home.
The meeting ended; we went home.
After the meeting ended, we went home.
The meeting ended we went home.

questions.question_text: Identify the type of sentence: "Although it was raining, the team completed the match."
questions.explanation: One independent and one dependent clause.

questions.question_text: Identify the type of sentence: "He worked hard, but he failed."
Identify the type of sentence: "She smiled."
In "The report that she wrote was excellent", the underlined clause "that she wrote" is a:
In "I know that he is honest", the clause "that he is honest" is a:
In "He left because he was tired", the clause "because he was tired" is an:
The word "quickly" in "He answered quickly" is a(n):
The word "since" in "She has not called since morning" is a:
The word "since" in "Since it was late, we left" is a:
Choose the correct option: "The ___ of the project was delayed by the inclement weather."
Choose the sentence with the correct tense sequence.
options: He said that he is waiting since an hour.
He said that he was wait for an hour.
He said that he had been waiting for an hour.
He said that he has been waiting for an hour.
questions.explanation: Past perfect continuous after a past reporting verb.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option: "The more you practise, ___ you become."
Choose the correct option: "She is the ___ of the two sisters."
Choose the correct option: "He gave ___ information about the product."
Choose the correct option: "There ___ several reasons for the delay."
